scope_definition: EU27 + EEA/EFTA (NO, IS, LI) + CH + UK + US + CA + AU + NZ. Country-level procurement coverage; subnational supplements tracked separately where national portals do not aggregate them.

status_semantics.LIVE_NATIONAL: national opportunity source is machine-harvested in the production discovery workflow
status_semantics.TED_LIVE: jurisdiction is continuously covered by the TED EU/EEA backbone for TED-published notices
status_semantics.ARCHIVE_RUNNING: national or supranational bulk/archive lane is harvested or already normalized
status_semantics.DCE_CASCADE: public documents are attempted through explicit URLs, notice/detail/proceeding pages, HTTP anchors and browser-rendered anchors; auth/CAPTCHA remains explicit
status_semantics.MAPPED_BLOCKED: route is identified but a current technical/access blocker prevents a national automated lane; another running backbone/archive lane still covers the jurisdiction

jurisdictions.name: Austria
jurisdictions.notes: EU/EEA TED backbone is running; national below-threshold publications are a supplement, not assumed covered by TED.

jurisdictions.name: Belgium
jurisdictions.notes: Belgian e-Procurement route exists in portal resolver; national below-threshold machine feed remains a supplement.

jurisdictions.name: Bulgaria
jurisdictions.notes: CAIS EOP national portal mapped; TED runs continuously.

jurisdictions.name: Croatia
jurisdictions.notes: EOJN national portal mapped; TED backbone running.

jurisdictions.name: Denmark
jurisdictions.notes: National supplement is mapped; TED remains running backbone.

jurisdictions.name: Finland
jurisdictions.notes: HILMA/AVP national API mapped; credential/access requirements are not bypassed.

jurisdictions.name: Italy
jurisdictions.notes: ANAC CIG delta is deliberately not mislabeled as open-bid live data.

jurisdictions.name: Latvia
jurisdictions.notes: IUB daily lane is lifecycle-heavy and therefore not promoted to current opportunities.

jurisdictions.name: Portugal
jurisdictions.notes: BASE API authorization is not bypassed.

jurisdictions.name: Sweden
jurisdictions.notes: No single official national aggregator is assumed where the ecosystem is fragmented.

jurisdictions.name: Norway
jurisdictions.notes: National N4/N16/N29 below-threshold notices do not flow to TED; Doffin national lane is therefore being solved separately.

jurisdictions.name: Switzerland
jurisdictions.notes: Anonymous API use is permitted; frontend-network fallback is used only to reproduce public browser access, never to bypass auth.

jurisdictions.name: Australia
jurisdictions.notes: RSS and browser public listing both return 403 from GitHub cloud; blocker is preserved, not bypassed.

United States: state/local portals remain a separate future supplement; federal SAM is live now

hard_rule: A jurisdiction is never declared nationally complete merely because TED is live. TED is the EU/EEA backbone; national below-threshold supplements remain explicit. DCE access controls are never bypassed.
